body:
I'll approve, since I originally suggested this and I think when we add compatibility flags, it is best to keep the default for one minor version, and then reset to the default from that point forward.

Most assets should already have a fbx/naming_version or gltf/naming_version already set in the .import file, so I suspect this will mostly only affect assets from 4.0 or 4.1.

If people are having any trouble for project assets, we can always tell users to roll forward one minor version at a time, or change the import settings manually.

The only issue I can think of with this change is that there could be standalone assets made in Godot 4.0 or 4.1, such as from the asset library, where this could possibly not upgrade them any more.

I just think there isn't enough content still on 4.0 or 4.1 to warrant making a bad default for everyone else.
